wonder.ask: I've seen everything your garden can show me. Let me go and see the rest.
wonder.go: Look up sometimes. I'll be in the part you haven't seen yet.

mirth.ask: I've laughed myself full. Time I took it home and shared it round.
mirth.go: Ha! Don't go quiet without me.

desire.ask: There's somewhere I want to be more than here, and it's home.
desire.go: I'll want to come back. That's how you'll know it was good.

fury.ask: I've burned down to embers here. Let me go home and cool.
fury.go: No hard feelings. Not one left.

gall.ask: Fine. It was better than I expected. Now let me go before I admit it.
gall.go: Don't make a thing of it.

grief.ask: You held it with me long enough. I can carry it home now.
grief.go: It's lighter. Thank you for that.

dread.ask: I'm not afraid any more, and that's how I know it's time to go.
dread.go: Leave a light on. Not for me. Just leave it on.
